title: FidelityBaseline
description: The approved rendering the visual comparison judges against. A committed golden file, written only by an explicit update command and never as a side effect of comparing. See ../research.md, 'Capturing and updating the baseline'.

image.description: Path to the approved rendering, relative to this file

x-constraints-not-expressible-in-json-sc: surfaces[].name must be unique, and must appear in failure output so a reader knows which surface moved without opening an image
a reference_size differing from the current constant is an error, not a pass: comparing at a different size is meaningless
an absent or unreadable baseline is an error, never a pass
